name: design-system
description: Filip's design language for agents: the spec, the tokens, the component catalogue, and the decisions behind them.

interface.shortDescription: Give UI, mockup, and visual work one consistent look.
interface.longDescription: The design-system skill points the agent at the design language: selection rules and acceptance checks, the tokens, every component with its states, and the decisions behind them. It reads the files bundled with the plugin, so they update with the plugin.
